ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 32381, February 3, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures Following Changes in Appointing Authorities for Specialist Members, Research Members and the Secretary, etc.)
Specialist members, research members and the secretary appointed or commissioned under former Article 7 (2) and (4) as at the time this Decree enters into force shall be deemed specialist members, research members and the secretary appointed, commissioned or designated by the Minister of Justice pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 7 (2) and (5).
